extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Root types — two main types: tap root (one main thick root with smaller side roots — carrot, mustard, radish, mango) and fibrous root (many thin roots of same size growing from base — grass, maize, wheat, onion). Tap roots store food (carrot, radish). (2) Photosynthesis — green leaves make food using sunlight (photo = light, synthesis = putting together). Chlorophyll (green pigment) traps sunlight. Raw materials: sunlight, water (from roots through stem), carbon dioxide (from air through leaf pores). Products: starch (food) and oxygen (released into air). Simple equation: carbon dioxide + water + sunlight = food (starch) + oxygen. Iodine test proves starch: iodine turns blue-black when starch is present. (3) Transpiration — plants lose water vapour through tiny pores on leaves called stomata. This is like sweating. Transpiration cools the plant and pulls more water up from roots. (4) Composition of air — air is a mixture: nitrogen 78 percent, oxygen 21 percent, carbon dioxide 0.04 percent, other gases (argon, helium, water vapour) about 1 percent. Oxygen is needed for breathing and burning. (5) Breathing and burning — breathing: living things take in oxygen and release carbon dioxide, happens in lungs, keeps us alive. Burning: needs oxygen to burn, releases carbon dioxide and heat and light, fire needs fuel + oxygen + heat. Both use oxygen and release carbon dioxide. Misconceptions: 'plants breathe in oxygen like animals' (plants make their own food through photosynthesis and release oxygen — they use oxygen only at night when there is no sunlight), 'air is mostly oxygen' (air is mostly NITROGEN at 78 percent, oxygen is only 21 percent), 'starch test uses water' (starch test uses IODINE which turns blue-black with starch), 'transpiration is the same as photosynthesis' (transpiration is water loss through leaf pores, photosynthesis is food making — they are different processes), 'burning and breathing are the same' (both use oxygen and release CO2, but burning needs fuel and produces heat and light, breathing happens in living cells to release energy from food). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function PlantsAirGame), NOT export default. Export interface PlantsAirGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void. Use double quotes for ALL strings containing apostrophes. Use 'currentChallenge' as variable name, NOT 'challenge'. Auto-hint timer MUST be exactly 10000ms.
